email.body1:
Mark, saw Legion hit FedRAMP High and launch Mission Packs and Centurion III at SOF Week.

Milestones like that usually open more in-market agencies and programs than a BD team can personally work before the window closes, and uncovered accounts are where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Legion off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Mark, quick follow-up for Legion.

After a FedRAMP milestone and new launches, the pipeline target usually grows faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Legion needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mark, last bit of proof for Legion.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Legion's reply rate likely compares to other defense-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
